question: What southern boundary completes the delimitation of the sacred region?
premises: The Brahmaputra and Lākṣā are named.
The boundary extends up to their confluence.
inference: The southern limit of the region is the confluence of the Brahmaputra and the Lākṣā.
plain_english: In the south, the boundary extends up to the confluence of the Brahmaputra and the Lākṣā.
